title: A Spring Cleaning and Organizing MUST!
text: A Spring Cleaning and Organizing MUST!. This is a great item to have! I started getting organized and love this handy, well- made, all in one little rack. It keeps everything handy and all together for ironing - but behind the door so it’s out of sight when not using it. No more dragging the ironing board out of the garage- then trying to find the iron because I was too lazy to get the board and ironed somewhere like on top of the washer or on a towel on a table! A must have! Love it!

product_metadata.title: mDesign Steel Metal Over Door Ironing Board Holder with Large Storage Basket for Laundry, Utility, Mudroom, Garage - Holds Iron, Board, Spray Bottles, Starch, Detergent, Fabric Refresher - Chrome
features: SMART STORAGE: Make ironing a little less of a chore with this convenient storage solution; Hang over laundry room doors to create additional storage for your iron, ironing board, water mister, fabric sprays, starch, wrinkle releaser, stain sticks and more; Great for additional home storage throughout the home - the versatile basket holds a multitude of items and you can use the hooks to hang brooms, mops, reusable grocery bags, dust cloths, feather dusters, dog leashes and more

SPACE-SAVING: Maximize your space and eliminate laundry room clutter with this handy organizer; Utilize extra space in laundry/utility rooms to create convenient storage; Free up space in cabinets, countertops, shelves and more; Keep ironing supplies close at hand and ready to use; Ideal for small, crowded, or cramped laundry and mudrooms

FUNCTIONAL & VERSATILE: Installs instantly by hanging over interior doors; Works in any room of the home - try this in your kitchen, pantry, craft room, garage, basement, entryway, mudroom, laundry/utility room and more; The space-saving design is also perfect for small spaces like college dorm rooms, boats, RVs, campers, apartments, cabins, and condos
QUALITY CONSTRUCTION: Made of strong steel wire with a durable finish; Easy Care - Clean with damp cloth
THOUGHTFULLY SIZED: Measures 7.1" x 13.53" x 20" high; Fits over interior doors up to 1.4" / 3.6cm thick
